summary: A pilot procedure is set conduct the agent can follow to reach a certain outcome, taken from the decisions and orders that come up often.
statement: [PP] Pilot procedures are predefined conduct the agent can make to achieve a certain outcome. procedures are extracted from prominent decisions and orders, made by the pilot and commander.
context: The last of the pilot's record types, line 82 of cockpit.constitution, closing the Pilot section. The commander gives the point of it in the same paragraph: "This enables the pilot to announce a procedure inplace of producing a decision." Line 47 names procedures as one of the places the commander's records are built into, and line 72 allows a decision to be turned into one.
